title: Aligned routing with authoritative evidence surfaces
points: Current P/E and P/B questions now use the aligned valuation_inputs package instead of independently timed market and earnings lanes.
Report inventory is counted from filing records rather than the listed-company market universe.
Dividend-payer rankings use the deterministic cash-flow-dividend yield screen, with signed values scaled and ranked on an auditable absolute-payout basis.
Invalid selector dependency graphs receive one Router-authored corrective retry instead of being rewritten after routing.
Announcement and filing searches remain independent evidence paths, so one narrative corpus cannot suppress the other through a selector dependency.
Ticker follow-ups keep the most recent entity-bearing conversation scope instead of merging older company subjects into a new plan.
Analyst-selected table and source markers are emitted before long answer prose, preserving auditable attachments without runtime-inferred evidence.
Known source quarantines remain explicit XFAILs in model evals and cannot be bypassed merely to produce a forecast.
